text:
deploy-bot: Canary alert: rollout 2.7.1 -> traffic slice us-west-2 10% breached p95 latency threshold (470ms > 350ms). Suggested action: AUTO-ROLLBACK to v2.7.0 in 5m unless acknowledged. :warning:

mike.dev: seeing the same in grafana, request ids spike on transformer-gpu nodes.

sofia.eng: tagging @jen-releases and @carol-ops — want to avoid full auto rollback because dedicated EU customers are in the slice for a small subset. can we do targeted rollback by routing policy?

jen-releases: canary is 10% user traffic. we have an active commit with kvcache hotfix on main which would fix the regression but not ready to deploy. prefer throttled traffic back to 0% gradual if ops can hold.

carol-ops: we can cut the canary to 2% immediately. do we have a quick command?

ops-runner: runbook snippet: `releasesctl traffic set --release 2.7.1 --slice us-west-2 --percent 2` then `deploy-bot ack-manual` to suppress auto-rollback for 30m.

mike.dev: omg yes, reduce to 2% now pls. doing live traces to see error class.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged: holding auto-rollback timer for 30m (manual ack by @mike.dev). If performance doesn't stabilize, auto-rollback will resume.

sofia.eng: quick check — are embeddings and text-gen routed to same pool? I want to make sure fallback won't route heavy embedding jobs to small nodes.

mike.dev: embeddings go to dedicated-pool-eu, not in this slice. this regression looks like kv-cache misses + longer decode on long-left-pad prompts.

jen-releases: draft customer note: "We observed elevated latency for a portion of traffic in us-west-2; we've temporarily reduced rollout while we investigate. No action needed from customers." Should we push?

carol-ops: yes send a short status update to #customer-ops Slack and add a one-line to release notes: `Rolled back canary to 2% due to elevated p95 latency; investigating.`

mike.dev: logs show 502 spikes correlate with a new kernel flag enabled in 2.7.1: `--fused-attn-v2`. Trying to repro locally with load testing.

sofia.eng: if it's kernel flag, can we flip the flag on 2.7.1 and re-run canary instead of reverting entirely? That might be faster than full rollback.

jen-releases: option A: rollback to 2.7.0 fully (fast, simple). Option B: toggle kernel flag and keep model version (requires safe toggle path and test). Decision tree?

carol-ops: timeline: do we want to keep suppression of auto-rollback while we test flag? we have 18m left on ack.

mike.dev: I'll attempt a staged flag toggle on a single node pool and run a synthetic blast. If we see p95 drop below 320ms, we can scale percent back up.

deploy-bot: manual annotation: `acknowledged_by: mike.dev`, `hold_expires_at: 1755561799`.

ops-runner: if toggle works, command to flip flag on rollout: ```
releasesctl flag update --release 2.7.1 --set fused_attn_v2=false --scope us-west-2
releasesctl traffic set --release 2.7.1 --slice us-west-2 --percent 10
```

jen-releases: agreed. fallback plan if toggle fails: execute full rollback script below and run customer comms: ```
releasesctl rollback --from 2.7.1 --to 2.7.0 --regions us-west-2,us-east-1 --mode staged
notify --channel customer-ops --template quick-latency-rollback
```

carol-ops: I'll prep the notify template and stand by for the rollback command. also opening a quick incident ticket for audit: INC-1755.

mike.dev: toggle test started on pool `staging-fuse-1` — running 2k synthetic requests. will post perf samples in 3m.

sofia.eng: thanks. if we need to roll back, let's include a short postmortem checklist: root cause, mitigation, follow-up for kernel flag gating, and regression test added to preflight.

deploy-bot: Update: synthetic test p95=310ms (baseline 290ms). Stability looks ok for this sample. Manual hold extended by @mike.dev for 1h.

jen-releases: with successful test, proceed to 10% ramp over 10m and monitor. I'll update release notes and the customer ops message.

carol-ops: ramping traffic: `releasesctl traffic set --release 2.7.1 --slice us-west-2 --percent 5` -> done.

mike.dev: monitoring — p95 holding ~325ms. no new 502 spikes.

sofia.eng: close the loop: add a follow-up action to change default for fused_attn_v2 to disabled for canary rollouts until QA signs off.

jen-releases: created follow-up ticket REL-5124 for default flag gating + preflight. I'll draft slack customer note and post to #customer-ops.

carol-ops: posting now. good job team. :tada:

deploy-bot: Final: auto-rollback suppressed. No rollback executed. Thread closed after handoff to REL-5124 and INC-1755.
